connector.meaning: Listed by the request reader but not used: the configured firmware reference selects the files to remove.

dry-run.meaning: Plan file edits and rebuild commands without applying them when true.

observed.meaning: The pre-operation HDMI state on a plan/no-op, or the nidus per-file before/after digest rows after the writer runs. The front door supplies null when the stop refused before providing an observation.

mutationPerformed.meaning: The writer reported changed files when it completed; false on a read, plan, no-op or a handled refusal.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when an unexpected fault is reported by the front door instead of the stop.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Absent when the stop emits no signal. The enum lists literal outcomes. Non-token intake or system exceptions are reported as hdmi-hold-release-failed:<exception class>.

could_change_to.meaning: A plan has files with actions, modes, digests and optional text, and rebuild argv/deadlines; once the writer runs, this part lists writer target paths. The front door supplies null when the stop did not provide this part.

attempt.meaning: Whether the writer tried to change files and the ordered steps it records. The front door supplies null when the stop did not provide this part.

final_receipt.meaning: Final verdict and, when carried, the writer or front-door signal; a plan returns ok only.

changed.meaning: False before the write; the nidus writer supplies its changed verdict if called.

effective.meaning: The operation changes boot configuration, not the running connector.

restore_failed.meaning: A file or reload compensation failed, when the writer failed.
